https://miniswap.gg/mga Get your miniatures graded in a never ending painting competition! Lots of great feedback! Launch Discount: 30% off every submission. Ends December 2nd! Bulk discounts are also available!

He also goes through his collection to see if he can get a mini graded at every level! We have new videos every Monday, Wednesday and Friday!
